home.heroTitle: Bedding and fabrics trusted for years
home.heroSubtitle: 100% cotton, custom sewing to any size, and delivery across Ukraine in 1–2 days.

advantagesItems.title: 100% cotton
advantagesItems.text: Tirotex poplin, Turkish stripe satin, and Pakistani satin — only trusted materials.

advantagesItems.title: Made to size
advantagesItems.text: We'll make a set or a single item to any non-standard size in 1–5 days.

advantagesItems.title: Fast delivery
advantagesItems.text: Nova Poshta and Ukrposhta across Ukraine. Ready-made items ship within 1–2 days.

advantagesItems.title: Wholesale discounts
advantagesItems.text: Favorable terms for wholesale buyers and the hospitality business (HoReCa).

deliveryItems.title: Nova Poshta / Ukrposhta
deliveryItems.text: We deliver across Ukraine. Ready-made items ship within 1–2 days, custom orders in 2–5 days.

deliveryItems.title: Payment
deliveryItems.text: To our business bank account, or cash on delivery when you receive your order.

deliveryItems.title: Wholesale & retail
deliveryItems.text: Fabrics are sold in rolls of 50–60 m or cut from 1 meter. Favorable prices for wholesalers.

home.aboutParagraph1: Light Textiles is a Ukrainian manufacturer of bedding, towels, and fabrics with over 10 years of experience. Our production facility is located in Radomyshl, Zhytomyr region.
home.aboutParagraph2: We work only with 100% cotton fabrics — Tirotex poplin (Moldova), stripe satin (Turkey), and satin (Pakistan) — sewing both ready-made collections and custom orders in non-standard sizes for homes and the hospitality business.

returnsItems.title: 14 days to return
returnsItems.text: Unused items can be returned or exchanged within 14 days of receiving your order.

returnsItems.title: Custom-made items
returnsItems.text: Items sewn to individual measurements cannot be returned, except in case of a manufacturing defect.

returnsItems.title: How to start
returnsItems.text: Message us on Viber, by email, or through the contact form below and we'll guide you through the next steps.

pages.customOrderSubtitle: We'll make bedding, towels, or hospitality textiles to any non-standard size — in 1 to 5 days.

customOrderSteps.title: Send a request
customOrderSteps.text: Tell us the sizes, fabric, and quantity you need using the form below, or give us a call.

customOrderSteps.title: We confirm the details
customOrderSteps.text: A manager will reach out within one business day, help pick the fabric, and quote the price.

customOrderSteps.title: We sew and ship it
customOrderSteps.text: The finished item ships via Nova Poshta or Ukrposhta within 1–5 days.
